Found the relevant API. Let me grab the source from Cairath's mod to see the exact pattern.

The game already has built-in checks. The vanilla `ColonyAchievementTracker.UnlockPlatformAchievement` skips achievements when `Game.Instance.debugWasUsed` is `true`. Simplest approach: set that flag when your mod attaches.
Just add one line to the `Game_OnSpawn_Patch`:

That's it. `Game.Instance.debugWasUsed = true` is the same flag the game sets when you use debug/sandbox mode. The vanilla `ColonyAchievementTracker.UnlockPlatformAchievement` already checks this and skips Steam achievement unlocks when it's set.

The flag persists on the save file, so once the REPL has been loaded on a colony, achievements stay disabled for that save even if the mod is later removed.
